name: Murakami (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Murakami city emblem in green and orange: a green stylised swirl with a curved stroke and an orange disc.
history: Municipal flag of Murakami, a city in Niigata Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 2008.

features.role: Murakami city emblem — a green stylised swirl with a curved stroke and an orange disc
